name: Deferred Shading with Alpha-Blended Feature Maps
aliases: Deferred Shading with Aggregated Feature Maps
definition: A rendering approach where material properties (albedo, metallic, roughness, normal) are aggregated into pixel-level feature maps via alpha-blending of 2D Gaussians, and the rendering equation is applied in a deferred shading pass. This treats alpha-blending as a smoothing filter to stabilize optimization and produce cohesive results, unlike shading directly on Gaussians before blending.
summary: Deferred Shading with Alpha-Blended Feature Maps renders relightable 3D Gaussians by aggregating material properties into pixel-level maps, stabilizing optimization and producing cohesive results.
